name: Ricky
source:
"Sign here!!"

Affiliation: Eclipse - Thoth Department
Role: Chief
Ability: Earth manipulation

Ricky is the world’s foremost artifact engineer and jeweler—a genius whose innovations have reshaped both science and society. Alongside President Sabrina of Maat, she co-developed groundbreaking artifacts capable of producing supernatural phenomena without a natural gift.

Her curiosity toward supernatural powers borders on obsession. To Ricky, people are only worth remembering if they possess something truly exceptional. Aside from the Prophet, Rianne, and Sabrina, she recalls no one by name—only “valuable specimens” earn her attention.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yuri-eclipse/yuri-x-manga-x-visual-noveleclipse/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
